tools.description:
Verify a geeky-plan folder contains the artifacts geeky-implement needs.

Checks for implementation-plan.md, kanban.md, references.md, handoff.md, and a
non-empty tasks/ folder; reports missing recommended files (feature-specification.md,
draft.md) as warnings.

Args:
    params (FolderInput): folder = absolute path to the planning folder.

Returns:
    dict: { ok: bool, task_count: int, missing_required: [str],
            missing_recommended: [str], summary: str, exit_code: int }.
    ok=false with exit_code=1 means the folder is incomplete (a validation
    failure, not a server error).

folder.description: Absolute path to the geeky-plan planning folder (contains kanban.md, tasks/, etc.)
folder.title: Folder

tools.name: geeky_validate_planning_folder

tools.description:
Validate that task files carry the required template sections.

The plan->implement boundary gate. Required sections: Task Name, In scope,
Dependencies, Acceptance Criteria, Tests/Validation, Priority. Missing
recommended sections (Context, Module/System, Technical Notes, Definition of
Done, Estimate) are warnings.

Args:
    params (TaskSchemaInput): provide 'folder' (validate all tasks/Tx-*.md) OR
        'file' (validate one task .md).

Returns:
    dict: { ok: bool, results: [ { file, ok, missing_required, missing_recommended } ],
            exit_code: int }.

file.description: A single task .md file to validate instead of a whole folder
file.title: File

folder.description: Planning folder; validates every tasks/Tx-*.md in it
folder.title: Folder

tools.name: geeky_validate_task_schema

tools.description:
Check kanban.md integrity against the tasks/ folder.

Errors (ok=false): a task file placed in no lane (untracked); a task in more
than one lane (ambiguous). Warnings: dangling references, WIP cap exceeded,
missing lane headings.

Args:
    params (KanbanInput): folder = planning folder; wip = In Progress cap (default 3).

Returns:
    dict: { ok: bool, errors: [str], warnings: [str], lane_counts: {lane:int},
            summary: str, exit_code: int }.

folder.description: Planning folder containing kanban.md and tasks/
folder.title: Folder

wip.description: In Progress WIP cap before a warning is raised
wip.title: Wip

tools.name: geeky_validate_kanban

tools.description:
Verify a task's Definition of Done before it moves to Done.

Asserts: a per-task notes file tasks/<ID>-*.notes.md exists; <ID> is in the Done
lane; handoff.md mentions <ID>. Also returns the task's Tests/Validation block so
the caller can re-run it ("verify, don't trust").

Args:
    params (DodInput): folder = planning folder; task = task id (e.g. 'T3').

Returns:
    dict: { ok: bool, task: str, errors: [str], warnings: [str], lanes: [str],
            validation_block: str, exit_code: int }.
tools.name: geeky_check_dod

tools.description:
Validate a Conventional Commits subject and task reference (or docs-only none).

Errors (ok=false): subject not 'type(scope): summary'; subject > 72 chars; no
task reference; 'Tasks: none' on a non-docs commit. A case-insensitive
'Tasks: none' line satisfies the task rule for docs commits. A bare T<n>
without a 'Tasks:' line is a warning, not an error.

Args:
    params (CommitInput): message = full commit message text.

Returns:
    dict: { ok: bool, subject: str, errors: [str], warnings: [str], exit_code: int }.

message.description: The full commit message text to validate
message.title: Message

tools.name: geeky_check_commit

annotations.title: Check if a path is a frozen artifact

tools.description:
Check whether a file path is a frozen geeky-plan planning artifact.

Use this as a pre-edit guardrail (the in-process equivalent of the PreToolUse
guard hook): call it before editing a file inside a planning folder. During
plan-review, implementation-plan.md, draft.md, references.md and tasks/Tx-*.md
bodies are editable; a bounded mechanical edit needs a changed-content check and
a scope, requirement, AC or sequencing edit needs a fresh verdict. feature-specification.md stays frozen. Missing stages and
implement freeze all those artifacts. Notes, kanban and handoff stay mutable.

Args:
    params (FrozenInput): file_path = the path an agent intends to edit;
        stage = plan-review or implement (default unknown, treated as frozen).

Returns:
    dict: { frozen: bool, file_path: str, reason: str|None, exit_code: int }.
    frozen=true means do not edit — surface plan issues via kanban Blocked + handoff.md.

file_path.description: Path an agent intends to edit; checks whether it is a frozen planning artifact
file_path.title: File Path

stage.description: Workflow stage; plan-review permits planning edits with review invalidation. Omitted stages keep the planning contract frozen.
stage.title: Stage

tools.name: geeky_check_frozen_artifact

tools.description:
Report the shared workflow deadline, reserve and stage target.

Same report as `scripts/workflow-budget.py --stage <stage> --json`, read from
this server's GEEKY_DEADLINE_UTC, GEEKY_CLOSEOUT_RESERVE_S and
GEEKY_HARD_WALL_BUDGET_S. Use it for in-stage rechecks: it skips the agent
shell's startup cost. Read 'status' and 'action', not only 'ok': reserve
still exits 0.

Args:
    params (BudgetInput): stage = current workflow stage.

Returns:
    dict: { status: unbounded|active|reserve|exhausted|invalid, action: str,
            remaining_s, usable_s, stage_target_utc, stage_target_exceeded,
            ok: bool, exit_code: int }. exit_code 2 = invalid, 3 = exhausted.

stage.description: Workflow stage whose cumulative advisory target to report
stage.title: Stage

tools.name: geeky_workflow_budget
